_about: Every public-domain Richard Baxter (1615-1691) text the Word Hoard holds. The target is Orme's edition of the Practical Works (London, 1830), 23 volumes, vol. 1 being William Orme's Life (Orme d. 1830). All 23 volumes are held as raw IA OCR, unconverted (the Edwards precedent); no single scan series is complete, so the set mixes Toronto, other library and Google/BSB scans, and each volume number was read off the title-page OCR. Every CCEL Baxter title is held as clean ThML, and Gutenberg's four-part Christian Directory (rights lines checked by the fetcher). Modern reprints are excluded.
